title: Contract-first engineering
summary: Define the machine-checkable contract for an API, message or file format before implementation, keep one source of truth, and verify provider and consumers against it.

provenance.notes: Specialized for this repository where contracts are zod schemas and JSON envelopes; the same workflow applies to OpenAPI or protobuf.

inputs.name: boundary
inputs.description: The interface between two components or clients.

outputs.name: contract
outputs.description: The schema or interface definition that is the single source of truth.

outputs.name: conformance
outputs.description: Tests proving provider and consumers conform to it.

workflow.step: Find or create the single contract definition for the boundary; point every other description at it.
workflow.check: There is exactly one authoritative definition.

workflow.step: Specify required and optional fields, error shapes, limits, and what an unknown field means.
workflow.check: Unknown fields are explicitly rejected or explicitly ignored, never accidental.

workflow.step: Decide the compatibility rule: additive-only within a version, version bump otherwise.
workflow.check: Removals and renames are treated as breaking.

workflow.step: Write conformance tests from the contract for the provider and at least one consumer.
workflow.check: A test fails when a required field is dropped.

workflow.step: Implement against the contract and rerun the conformance tests; update the contract first if the design changes.

constraints: Do not change a published contract in place; version it.
Validate untrusted input at the boundary with the contract itself, not with ad hoc checks.
Do not widen a task's allowed files to edit consumers; report them as follow-up work.

examples.title: New optional field
examples.situation: An envelope gains an optional field.
examples.guidance: Add it to the schema as optional, add a conformance test with and without it, and keep older consumers passing.

verification: Provider and consumer tests both derive from the contract definition.
A removed or renamed field is caught by a failing test.

task.text: Define the contract and json schema for the new envelope, backward compatible.
Review the api design for the versioned api and wire format.
Why does the contract test crash with the schema?
Pick a color for the dashboard.
